<style>
:root {
  /* Brand */
  --green: #8BC4A9;
  --green-500: #74B395;
  --forest: #4C6D5E;
  --forest-700: #3D5A4D;
  --forest-800: #2F473C;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  /* Supporting */
  --warm-white: #FFFDF9;
  --sage-25: #FAFCFA;
  --sage-50: #F4F8F5;
  --sage-100: #EAF3EE;
  --sage-150: #E0EDE5;
  --sage-200: #D3E5DA;
  --line: #E4ECE7;
  --ink: #2C3832;
  --ink-2: #4E5C55;
  --muted: #74827A;
  --muted-2: #9AA79F;
  /* Status (soft, never used for chart series) */
  --st-draft-bg: #F0F2F1;   --st-draft: #5F6B65;
  --st-sched-bg: #E7F0F8;   --st-sched: #3F6B8F;
  --st-pub-bg: #E4F2EA;     --st-pub: #2F7A55;
  --st-publishing-bg: #EEEBF8; --st-publishing: #5D52A0;
  --st-fail-bg: #FBEBEB;    --st-fail: #A8464C;
  --st-warn-bg: #FFF4DF;    --st-warn: #94661A;
  /* Platforms (muted, always paired with a text label) */
  --pf-instagram: #B85C8A;
  --pf-facebook: #4E6FAE;
  --pf-tiktok: #2C3832;
  --pf-youtube: #C4564F;
  --pf-pinterest: #A8495C;

  --radius-sm: 10px;
  --radius: 16px;
  --radius-lg: 22px;
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(47, 71, 60, .05);
  --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(47, 71, 60, .04), 0 6px 22px rgba(47, 71, 60, .06);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(47, 71, 60, .14);
  --font-head: "Amatic SC", "Patrick Hand", cursive;
  --font: "Plus Jakarta Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --sidebar-w: 252px;
  --sidebar-w-collapsed: 78px;
  --topbar-h: 72px;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; }
body {
  font-family: var(--font);
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--sage-50);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
a { color: var(--forest); }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
svg.i { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex: none; }
[data-icon] { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.muted { color: var(--muted); }

/* ---------- Layout ---------- */
.app { display: flex; min-height: 100vh; }
.main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

/* ---------- Sidebar ---------- */
.sidebar {
  width: var(--sidebar-w); flex: none;
  background: var(--white);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh;
  transition: width .22s ease;
  z-index: 30;
}
.sidebar-brand { padding: 18px 20px 14px; text-align: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.brand-full { width: 118px; height: auto; display: block; margin: 0 auto; }
.brand-mark { width: 38px; height: 38px; display: none; margin: 0 auto; }
.brand-sub {
  display: inline-block; margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--forest); background: var(--sage-100); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
}
.nav { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 14px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.nav-group { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted-2); padding: 14px 12px 6px; }
.nav-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 12px;
  color: var(--ink-2); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;
  position: relative; white-space: nowrap;
}
.nav-item:hover { background: var(--sage-50); color: var(--forest-700); }
.nav-item.active { background: var(--sage-100); color: var(--forest-800); font-weight: 600; }
.nav-item.active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -12px; top: 9px; bottom: 9px; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; background: var(--green); }
.nav-item .ico { color: var(--muted); }
.nav-item.active .ico, .nav-item:hover .ico { color: var(--forest); }
.nav-item .count { margin-left: auto; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--sage-150); color: var(--forest-700); border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 8px; }
.sidebar-foot { padding: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.collapse-btn {
  width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted);
}
.collapse-btn:hover { background: var(--sage-50); color: var(--forest); }

/* Collapsed */
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .sidebar { width: var(--sidebar-w-collapsed); }
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .brand-full,
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .brand-sub,
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .nav-item .label,
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .nav-item .count,
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .nav-group,
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .collapse-btn .label { display: none; }
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .brand-mark { display: block; }
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .sidebar-brand { padding: 20px 10px; }
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .nav-item,
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .collapse-btn { justify-content: center; padding: 11px; }
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .nav-group { display: block; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: 10px 8px; background: var(--line); font-size: 0; }
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .collapse-btn .ico { transform: scaleX(-1); }

/* ---------- Topbar ---------- */
.topbar {
  height: var(--topbar-h); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
  padding: 0 28px; background: rgba(250, 252, 250, .86);
  backdrop-filter: saturate(1.2) blur(10px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20;
}
.topbar-title { min-width: 0; }
.topbar-title h1 { font-family: var(--font-head); font-weight: 700; font-size: 34px; line-height: 1; margin: 0; color: var(--forest); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.topbar-title p { margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: 12.5px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.topbar-actions { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.search {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 280px;
  background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 0 12px; height: 40px; color: var(--muted);
}
.search:focus-within { border-color: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(139, 196, 169, .25); }
.search input { border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; font: inherit; color: var(--ink); width: 100%; }
.tz-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); padding: 0 6px; white-space: nowrap; }
.tz-chip svg.i { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.icon-btn {
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--white);
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink-2); position: relative;
}
.icon-btn:hover { border-color: var(--sage-200); color: var(--forest); }
.badge-dot { position: absolute; top: 9px; right: 10px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--st-fail); border: 2px solid var(--white); }
.notif-wrap { position: relative; }
.popover {
  position: absolute; right: 0; top: 48px; width: 340px; background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); padding: 8px; z-index: 40;
}
.popover h4 { margin: 6px 10px 8px; font-size: 13px; }

/* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px;
  border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px;
  text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
}
.btn svg.i { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--forest); color: var(--white); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--forest-700); }
.btn-soft { background: var(--sage-100); color: var(--forest-700); }
.btn-soft:hover { background: var(--sage-150); }
.btn-ghost { background: var(--white); border-color: var(--line); color: var(--ink-2); }
.btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--sage-200); color: var(--forest); }
.btn-sm { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 10px; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* ---------- Content ---------- */
.content { flex: 1; padding: 28px; max-width: 1360px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; outline: none; }
.loading { min-height: 60vh; display: grid; place-content: center; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); }
.loading img { width: 56px; margin: 0 auto 10px; animation: breathe 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes breathe { 50% { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: .7; } }

.sample-banner {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; margin-bottom: 22px;
  background: var(--warm-white); border: 1px dashed #E3CF9E; border-radius: var(--radius); color: #7A5A1E; font-size: 13.5px;
}
.sample-banner strong { color: #6A4C14; }
.sample-tag { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #FFF1D2; color: #8A6216; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; }

.greeting { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.greeting h2 { font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 44px; line-height: 1; margin: 0; color: var(--forest); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.greeting p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--muted); }

.grid { display: grid; gap: 20px; }
.kpis { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin-bottom: 20px; }
.row-2-1 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(0, 1fr); margin-bottom: 20px; }
.row-3-2 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 3fr) minmax(0, 2fr); }

.card { background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding: 22px; min-width: 0; }
.card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.card-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); }
.card-head .sub { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
.link-btn { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--forest); text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.link-btn:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* KPI tiles */
.kpi { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.kpi .kpi-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
.kpi .kpi-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); }
.kpi .kpi-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--sage-100); color: var(--forest); display: grid; place-items: center; }
.kpi .kpi-value { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; margin: 10px 0 4px; color: var(--ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.kpi .kpi-foot { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.delta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--st-pub); }
.delta.down { color: var(--st-fail); }
.kpi .spark { position: absolute; right: 22px; top: 68px; width: 84px; height: 34px; }

/* Segmented control */
.seg { display: inline-flex; background: var(--sage-50); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 11px; padding: 3px; }
.seg button { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; }
.seg button.on { background: var(--white); color: var(--forest-700); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }

/* Charts */
.chart { width: 100%; height: 240px; position: relative; }
.chart svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.chart .grid-line { stroke: var(--line); stroke-width: 1; }
.chart .axis-label { fill: var(--muted-2); font-size: 11px; font-family: var(--font); }
.chart-tip {
  position: fixed; pointer-events: none; z-index: 60; background: var(--forest-800); color: var(--white);
  font-size: 12.5px; padding: 8px 11px; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); white-space: nowrap;
}
.chart-tip b { display: block; font-size: 14px; }
.chart-summary { display: flex; gap: 22px; margin-bottom: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.chart-summary .big { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.chart-summary .lbl { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }

/* Platform followers */
.pf-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.pf-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 112px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 13.5px; cursor: default; }
.pf-row .bar-track { height: 10px; background: var(--sage-50); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; }
.pf-row .bar { height: 100%; background: var(--green); border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; min-width: 4px; transition: background .15s; }
.pf-row:hover .bar { background: var(--forest); }
.pf-row .num { font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; min-width: 52px; text-align: right; }

/* Platform chips */
.pf { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2); min-width: 0; }
.pf-dot { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 7px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--white); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; flex: none; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.pf-dot.sm { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 9px; }
.pf-stack { display: inline-flex; }
.pf-stack .pf-dot { border: 2px solid var(--white); margin-left: -5px; box-sizing: content-box; }
.pf-stack .pf-dot:first-child { margin-left: 0; }

/* Status pills */
.status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 10px 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; }
.status svg.i { width: 13px; height: 13px; stroke-width: 2.2; }
.status.draft { background: var(--st-draft-bg); color: var(--st-draft); }
.status.scheduled { background: var(--st-sched-bg); color: var(--st-sched); }
.status.publishing { background: var(--st-publishing-bg); color: var(--st-publishing); }
.status.published { background: var(--st-pub-bg); color: var(--st-pub); }
.status.failed { background: var(--st-fail-bg); color: var(--st-fail); }
.status.attention { background: var(--st-warn-bg); color: var(--st-warn); }

/* Upcoming posts */
.post-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.post-row {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center;
  padding: 12px; margin: 0 -12px; border-radius: 14px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; cursor: pointer;
}
.post-row + .post-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0 0 14px 14px; }
.post-row:hover { background: var(--sage-50); border-top-color: transparent; border-radius: 14px; }
.thumb { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 13px; display: grid; place-items: center; position: relative; color: var(--forest); flex: none; }
.thumb svg.i { width: 24px; height: 24px; stroke-width: 1.6; }
.thumb .vid { position: absolute; right: 4px; bottom: 4px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(47, 71, 60, .75); color: var(--white); display: grid; place-items: center; }
.thumb .vid svg.i { width: 10px; height: 10px; fill: currentColor; stroke-width: 0; }
.post-title { font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.post-caption { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; margin: 1px 0 6px; }
.post-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.post-meta .when { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.post-meta .when svg.i { width: 14px; height: 14px; color: var(--muted); }
.post-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; }

/* Quick actions */
.qa-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.qa {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--sage-25); text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px;
  transition: border-color .15s, background .15s, transform .15s;
}
.qa:hover { border-color: var(--sage-200); background: var(--sage-50); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.qa .qa-ico { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--forest); flex: none; }
.qa.primary { background: var(--forest); color: var(--white); border-color: var(--forest); }
.qa.primary .qa-ico { background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-color: transparent; color: var(--white); }
.qa.primary:hover { background: var(--forest-700); }

/* Activity */
.activity { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.act { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; }
.act + .act { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.act-ico { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; }
.act-ico svg.i { width: 15px; height: 15px; stroke-width: 2.2; }
.act-ico.success { background: var(--st-pub-bg); color: var(--st-pub); }
.act-ico.error { background: var(--st-fail-bg); color: var(--st-fail); }
.act-ico.warning { background: var(--st-warn-bg); color: var(--st-warn); }
.act-ico.info { background: var(--st-sched-bg); color: var(--st-sched); }
.act-msg { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink); }
.act-time { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }

/* Placeholder pages */
.placeholder { text-align: center; padding: 64px 24px; max-width: 620px; margin: 24px auto; }
.placeholder .ph-ico { width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--sage-100); color: var(--forest); display: grid; place-items: center; margin: 0 auto 18px; }
.placeholder .ph-ico svg.i { width: 32px; height: 32px; stroke-width: 1.5; }
.placeholder h2 { font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.05; margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--forest); }
.placeholder p { color: var(--muted); margin: 0 auto 18px; max-width: 460px; }
.phase-chip { display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--forest); background: var(--sage-100); padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.feature-list { text-align: left; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px 20px; margin: 20px auto 0; max-width: 520px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.feature-list div { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; }
.feature-list svg.i { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--green-500); margin-top: 2px; stroke-width: 2.4; }

/* Settings */
.kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr; gap: 10px 16px; font-size: 13.5px; }
.kv dt { color: var(--muted); }
.kv dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.swatches { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.swatch { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12.5px; }
.swatch i { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); display: block; }

/* Toast */
.toast {
  position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 24px; transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--forest-800); color: var(--white); padding: 11px 16px; border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); font-size: 13.5px; z-index: 80; max-width: calc(100% - 32px);
}

.scrim { display: none; }
.mobile-only { display: none; }

/* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .kpis { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .search { width: 200px; }
  .tz-chip { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .row-2-1, .row-3-2 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .search { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .mobile-only { display: inline-flex; }
  .sidebar {
    position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; transform: translateX(-100%);
    transition: transform .24s ease; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); width: var(--sidebar-w) !important;
  }
  .app.menu-open .sidebar { transform: none; }
  .app.menu-open .scrim { display: block; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(47, 71, 60, .3); z-index: 25; }
  /* On phones the drawer always shows the full sidebar */
  .app .brand-full { display: block !important; }
  .app .brand-mark { display: none !important; }
  .app .brand-sub, .app .nav-item .label, .app .nav-item .count, .app .nav-group { display: revert !important; }
  .app .nav-item { justify-content: flex-start !important; padding: 9px 12px !important; }
  .app .nav-group { height: auto !important; margin: 0 !important; background: none !important; font-size: 10.5px !important; padding: 14px 12px 6px !important; }
  .sidebar-foot { display: none; }
  .topbar { padding: 0 16px; gap: 10px; }
  .topbar-title h1 { font-size: 30px; }
  .topbar-title p { display: none; }
